questions.solution:

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between E and B, when counted from the right of E.

Only one person sits between A and B.

Only one person sits between D and A when counted from the right of D.

 Only one person sits between D and G.

Statements:

All boxes are glasses.

All glasses are cups.

Some cups are bottles.

Conclusions:

(I): All boxes are cups.

(II): Some glasses are bottles.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

(I): All boxes are cups → **True **(As, All boxes are glasses, All glasses are cups. so, All boxes are cups holds true)

Thus, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: OT11 is related to PU15 in a certain way. In the same way, WB21 is related to XC25. To which of the following is DI31 related, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

For OT11 : PU15

O (15) + 1 = P (16)

T (20) + 1 = U (21)

For WB21 : XC25

W (23) + 1 = X (24)

B (2) + 1 = C (3)

21 + 4 = 25

Similarly,

DI31:

D (4) + 1 = E (5)

I (9) + 1 = J (10)

31 + 4 = 35

Thus, DI31 is related to EJ35.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

66 × 6 − 15 ÷ 3 + 9 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given: 66 × 6 − 15 ÷ 3 + 9 = ?

According to the question, after ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged:

→ 66 ÷ 6 + 15 × 3 − 9 = ?

→ __**66 ÷ 6**__ + __**15 × 3**__ − 9 

→ __**11 + 45**__ − 9 

→ __**56 − 9**__ 

→ 47 

Hence, the correct answer is** 'Option 3".**
